desc:
• PANCAKE MIX: Pancake mix that makes fluffy, mouth-watering pancakes, waffles and more

  • QUICK AND EASY: Quick and easy breakfast option; just add water to pancake mix and pour onto griddle

  • WIN THE MORNING: This baking mix is a simple way to win over the family with delicious pancakes

  • ENDLESS OPTIONS: Easy to customize with fruits, nuts or chocolate chips

  • CONTAINS: 37 oz
features:
Features

Just Add Water
No eggs, milk, or oil required—simply mix with water and cook. Super easy and mess-free.

Made with Real Buttermilk
Infused with real buttermilk to deliver a rich, tangy flavor that tastes homemade.

Pancakes or Waffles
One mix does it all—prepare fluffy pancakes or crispy golden waffles using the same batter.

Large 37 oz Bag
Makes approximately 55 pancakes—great for large families, gatherings, or weekly breakfast prep.

Simple, Familiar Ingredients
Made with enriched flour, cornmeal, buttermilk, baking agents, and a touch of sugar for balanced flavor.

Allergen Info
Contains wheat, soy, and milk. May contain traces of egg.

Reliable Brand Quality
Backed by Betty Crocker’s trusted reputation in baking and breakfast mixes.

Benefits

Quick & Convenient Breakfast
Ideal for busy mornings—just stir, pour, and cook in minutes.

Delicious Buttermilk Taste
Adds a comforting, slightly tangy flavor that elevates your pancakes or waffles.

Budget-Friendly & Versatile
One bag serves multiple meals and can be used in creative recipes like mini muffins or breakfast casseroles.

Kid-Approved
Mild, fluffy, and easy to customize with chocolate chips, bananas, blueberries, or syrup.

Perfect for Meal Planning
Store the mix in your pantry and whip up batches as needed—great for weekly routines or brunch hosting.

Customizable Texture
Make them as thick or thin as you prefer—just adjust the water to suit your taste.
ingredients: Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Sugar, Degermed Yellow Corn Meal, Defatted Soy Flour, Palm Oil, Leavening (baking soda, sodium aluminum phosphate, monocalcium phosphate), Dextrose, Salt, Buttermilk, DATEM.
